decision_basis: At both common development cuts QRF has the smallest absolute dwarf median bias, the broadest dwarf 68 percent reference agreement, and the best mean signed Gaia score on the all-label and dwarf cohorts. The strict selection changes the radial composition, so retain both as registered observational samples.
inference_scope: Existing 13-field native DECam application envelope. Publishable magnitude, color and sky domains require external evidence. The present file defines validation workpoints and does not establish a release domain.
missing_evidence: Quantify in the weighted probability sample. Report lower and upper bounds with unidentified labels unresolved. Targeted reference fractions describe targeted matches.
